title: chrysanthemum nitens
intro: Chrysanthemum nitens, commonly known as the shining chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of C. nitens include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, as well as soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of C. nitens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal medicine.
